title: Why Courtship Still Matters
author: Chris Martin
source: The Ways of a Gentleman, February 19, 2026
summary: Martin revives traditional courtship principles for modern context. He argues that structured courtship with clear intentions removes uncertainty plaguing contemporary dating. Courtship conducted in public with family awareness protects intimacy while allowing genuine affection. The clarity that he's evaluating for marriage and she's evaluating the same removes games and disposability. Martin contrasts this with hook-up culture's ambiguity. He argues women appreciate honesty of intention, and men benefit from clarity about their own marriage intentions. Recovering courtship's accountability while adapting to modern life strengthens both masculine formation and feminine security.
points: Structured courtship with clear intentions removes uncertainty plaguing modern dating
Public courtship with family awareness protects intimacy and ensures accountability
Knowing intentions prevents emotional investment games; both evaluate for marriage
Women appreciate honesty when man states marriage intentions versus testing waters
Recovering courtship accountability without rejecting modernity strengthens both sexes
quotes: The traditional courtship of decades past might seem like a foreign concept when compared to the modern dating scene.
It was a rather structured process where a man made his intentions known early.
If he pursued a woman, it was understood that he was evaluating her for marriage, and she was most likely doing the same thing.
Knowing those intentions removed a lot of the uncertainty that defines modern dating.
Recovering even a measure of that accountability would be of tremendous value to young men and women.” Archived from The Ways of a Gentleman on May 2, 2026 by Tim.
